map.→ 打开由两点坐标反算方位角工具: -> Open the bearing from two coordinates tool
map.导线边方位推算。: Bearing deduction along a traverse line.
map.是。边 K = √(ΔN²+ΔE²)，方位角随 Δ 符号定象限，二者为导线基本元: Yes. The side length K = sqrt(dN^2 + dE^2), and the bearing fixes the quadrant by the sign of the deltas; both are basic traverse elements.
map.用 atan2(ΔE, ΔN)（东、北），不是普通 atan(ΔE/ΔN)，否则: Use atan2(dE, dN) (east, north) rather than a plain atan(dE/dN), otherwise quadrant boundaries get judged wrong.

map.输入北向增量 ΔN 与东向增量 ΔE，求方位角（0–360°）。: Enter northward difference dN and eastward difference dE to get the bearing (0-360 degrees).
